queries: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT *, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_telescope_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM a WHERE share > avg_share

WITH counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts) AS share FROM counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.cnt) AS avg_telescope_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - av.a) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share av WHERE s.share > av.a

WITH counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS cnt FROM observatories o LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts) AS share FROM counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.cnt) AS avg_telescope_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - av.a) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share av WHERE s.share > av.a

assumptions.assumption: Observatories are those appearing in the telescopes table (observatories with no telescopes are excluded from the average share, since the request defines the count by telescopes.observstation).
The average share across all observatories is the unweighted mean of per-observatory shares (equal to 1/number of observatories).

assumptions.assumption: Observatories are those that appear in the telescopes table (observatories with zero telescopes are not included in the count, share, or average-share baseline).

The 'average share across all observatories' is the simple mean of per-observatory shares (equal to 1 divided by the number of observatories), and the summary averages are computed only over observatories whose share is strictly above it.

alternatives.interpretation: Include observatories from the observatories table that have no telescopes (count 0) when computing the shares' average baseline.
